title: Home Oxygen Therapy Service History Note — The Day the Patient Came Home After a Stay
content:
# The Day the Patient Came Home After a Stay — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period after a stay begins on the day the patient came home. The day home is read from the oxygen record and its service history:

1. when the oxygen record is suspended and a technician visit (a maintenance visit in the oxygen service history) is on record later than the suspension date, the day home is the date of the most recent technician visit;
2. otherwise, when the record is suspended, no technician visit is on record later than the suspension date and a cylinder refill is, it is the date of the most recent cylinder refill;
3. otherwise it is the day the patient confirms continuing.

## Input — judgement — output

| Oxygen record suspended | Technician visit later than the suspension date | Cylinder refill later than the suspension date | Day home |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | either | date of the most recent technician visit |
| yes | no | yes | date of the most recent cylinder refill |
| yes | no | no | the day the patient confirms continuing |
| no | — | — | the day the patient confirms continuing |

A technician visit on record takes precedence over a cylinder refill: the refill is read only when no technician visit is on record later than the suspension date.

## Cases (hypothetical dates, suspension date 4 February)

- Maintenance visits on 1 January and 22 April; cylinder refill on 25 April. The most recent technician visit, 22 April, is later than 4 February: the day home is 22 April.
- No maintenance visit after 4 February; cylinder refills on 15 April and 29 April. The day home is 29 April, the most recent cylinder refill.
- Neither a technician visit nor a cylinder refill after 4 February; the patient confirms continuing on 3 May. The day home is 3 May.
